$comment: Every third-party artifact the stack runs, pinned. Update with a commit that says why.

locker.note: MinIO's own registries went private in 2025; Chainguard's build is public (free tier: :latest only, so we pin and bump digests ourselves). Same digest as the 96bulls-worker chart (D6).

otel-collector.note: matches the upstream opentelemetry-collector chart 0.178.0 used by the EKS stage; the AWS stage pulls it by this digest (stacks/aws/hardening.ts PINNED_IMAGES), digest re-resolved from Docker Hub for tag 0.163.2 on 2026-10-30

services-base.note: node:sqlite and node:zlib zstd need Bun >= 1.4

services.note: published 2026-10-30 from main 09293c8; immutable Artifact Registry tag sha-09293c8d649f912aa2f4414e31a3ad7fca6eceee; OCI index includes linux/amd64+arm64; image labels identify the exact source repository and revision; attestation manifests include SPDX SBOM and SLSA provenance.

cnpg-operator.note: CloudNativePG operator for the AWS proof stage's in-cluster HoopDb (helm-charts deps/pins.txt: cloudnative-pg chart 0.29.1); multi-arch index digest resolved from ghcr.io on 2026-10-30

cnpg-postgres.note: PG 17.11 with vector and pg_trgm; same digest as helm-charts deps/cnpg-cluster-values.yaml and the 96bulls 0.3.0 umbrella default

relaycast.note: Relaycast 8.0.0, pinned by helm-charts relaycast 0.1.0 values.yaml; the AWS stage takes chartVersion + imageDigest as inputs so 0.2.0 slots in

relayhistory.note: origin/main at release 0.53.0; provides the ai-hist Rust CLI (Concourse) and the Claude transcript fixtures

96bulls.note: version is the per-stage eks.chartVersion input; 0.3.0+ required

cert-manager.note: stacks/aws/relayauth-tls.ts; images pinned by digest there
